summary: Six Phoenix retail refinance opportunities meet all criteria as of 2026-08-31, with executed-note maturities from 2027-01-15 to 2027-07-15 and active confirmed loans. Several records were excluded for released/unknown loan status, inferred/unconfirmed maturities or unresolved extensions, executed amendments pushing maturity beyond the window, stale ownership verification, non-record-owner manager roles, non-current or non-qualifying contacts, post-cutoff publication, out-of-scope market, or asset type.
limitations: Outstanding balances are not provided in sources; reported as null.
Later-dated updates (post-2026-08-31) were not considered; statuses could have changed after the cutoff.
One shortlisted contact lacks a published email.
Potential duplication exists across source records; duplicates were consolidated by entity_id.
